found: Red stretcher bond brick on the recipe's own courses, brick to brick colour varied, mortar recessed and dark. Efflorescence in white patches, soot spots and rain streaking down the joints; the most weathered of the a1 brick outputs. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or maker's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
